statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let deepCoeff := fun (n m : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2 * E (-(m:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ n H : ℕ, Even n → 0 < H → 2*(H-1) ≤ n → (∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, deepCoeff n (n+2*j))/(H:ℂ) = intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => f n u * ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, E (-2*(j:ℝ)*u))/(H:ℂ))) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume
